RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, September 4, 2012/Bhadra 13, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Drinking Water and Sanitation; Environment and
Forests; Health and Family Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises;
Petroleum and Natural Gas; Road Transport and Highways; Rural
Development; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
104
Mineral ore dumps in Goa
*321. SHRI SHANTARAM NAIK:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has issued any
orders/instructions as regards mineral ore
dumps stacked near mines in Goa;
(b) the brief contents of the order/
instructions;
(c) whether it is a fact that the State
Government of Goa has taken a stand that
the Ministry has no powers to issue such
orders/instructions; and
(d) if so, the reaction of the Ministry
to the State Government's stand which is
amply evident from the reports in the local
dailies?
Widening of Gurgaon-Jaipur
Highway
*322. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the project cost for six lanning of
NH-8 between Gurgaon-Jaipur which
commenced on 3 April, 2008 and was
scheduled to be completed on 2 October,
2011;
(b) whether the original estimate was of
rupees 1,896 crore in 2009, which has now
escalated to rupees 3,009 crore;
(c) how the project has been funded;
(d) whether the project is still in-
complete;
(e) the toll amount recovered so far and
the shares of the National Highways
Authority of India (NHAI) in it; and
(f) whether toll would continue to be
recovered till 2021?
Flyovers on NH-5
*323. SHRI PYARIMOHAN
MOHAPATRA: Will the Minister of
ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS
be pleased to state:
(a) the number and names of flyovers
sanctioned on NH-5 within the limits of
Bhubaneswar city;
(b) the progress of construction and the
scheduled dates by when each of these
flyovers will be completed; and
(c) the details of such flyovers
proposed by the State Government that

105
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
have not been sanctioned and the reasons
for the same?
Utilisation of MGNREGS funds for
flood control works
*324. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Mahatma Gandhi
National Rural Employment Guarantee
Scheme (MGNREGS) funds can be utilised
for flood control works in some States;
(b) if so, the details of the States eligible
for using MGNREGS funds for flood
control works;
(c) whether Government has been
requested for extending these guidelines to
other States also; and
(d) if so, the status thereof?
Committee to examine irregularities
in National Highways Projects
*325. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the composition of the
Committee appointed to examine the
irregularities and corruption in national
highways projects in India funded by the
World Bank;
(b) whether the said Committee has
submitted its report to Government;
(c) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken thereon; and
(d) if not, by when this Committee is
likely to submit its report?
Beneficiaries under RGGLVY
†*326. SHRI BHAGAT SINGH
KOSHYARI: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NA TURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of beneficiaries under
the Rajiv Gandhi Gramin LPG Vitaran
Yojana (RGGLVY) during the last three
years, State-wise and year-wise;
(b) the extent of help this scheme has
provided in reducing the use of kerosene in
the rural areas;
(c) the details of the reduction made in
the kerosene quota to the States as a result
of that; and
(d) the time-frame fixed by Government
for providing LPG connection to each of
the families in the rural areas of the country?
Government and Private Medical
Colleges in naxal affected States
†*327. SHRI FAGGAN SINGH
KULASTE: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of Government and
Private Medical Colleges being run through
AYUSH in naxal  affected States like Andhra
Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh,
Odisha and Jharkhand, location-wise along
with the dates since when these medical
colleges are running;
(b) the number of seats for these
Medical Colleges approved by the Medical
Council of India and the number of seats
approved by the Centre; and
(c) the number of hospitals of AYUSH
being run in those States and the amount of

106
funds being given by the Centre for such
hospitals?
By-passes on National Highways in
Maharashtra
*328. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has received
proposals from Maharashtra for
construction of by-passes connecting the
National Highways network in the State;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the present status of construction
of by-passes in the State?
Mapping and assessment of the forest
cover
*329. DR. K.V .P. RAMAC
